title: IntentResult
description: Gemini's parsed understanding of a natural-language search query. This is the primary output of POST /intent and the input to POST /search.

intent_type.description: High-level classification of the user's intent. question_answering: user asked a factual question about a product or ingredient. substitute_request: user asked for an alternative to a specific product.

assistant.description: The AI assistant's conversational response to the query. Rendered above the product grid.

message.description: The assistant's response text. Empty string when tone is none.

tone.description: answer: factual answer to a question. clarify: AI needs more info. suggest: recommendation. none: no message to show.

follow_ups.description: Suggested follow-up queries shown as chips below the results.

keywords.description: Extracted search keywords derived from the intent, normalised to singular/base form.

on_sale.description: User expressed preference for sale items.

categories.description: WooCommerce category slugs or display names inferred from the query.

dietary.description: Dietary constraints, e.g. kosher, vegan, lactose-free, gluten-free.

servings.description: Number of people/servings mentioned in the query.

budget.description: Total budget in store currency if mentioned.

occasion.description: Social occasion, e.g. shabbat, birthday, weekday-dinner.

confidence.description: Model's self-reported confidence in the intent classification.
